name: Tarisa Manandal
source:
A member of Argus Test Flight. Stubborn, with a quick temper and a strong dislike of losing. Tarisa is a Gurkha, a tribe of brave mountain fighters. She particularly excels in high-speed hand-to-hand combat, and has developed her own unit style of high-speed tactics she calls the “Kukri Knife”.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
